context:
Goal: each repo's page is usable live and rebuildable anywhere, with git as the dataset.
Problem (rule): decision waiting-data-in-repo says git is each artifact's home and the claude.ai link is one account's view of it. Your item 593 a (12:40 CST Nov 12) says the page's database is the one store and git a timely backup; #2829 builds that. They differ on which is the truth. As built, git lags the database (measured 12:40 CST Nov 12: 519 items in git, 577 on the page), and page.html reads only the database.
Based on (ruling): waiting-data-in-repo, 2026-11-02 14:58 CST.
Based on (ruling): item 593 a, 2026-11-12 12:40 CST.
Based on (relayed): your 12:03 CST Nov 13 words, as the retrospective quotes them: "nothing points to a specific link of the artifact as the real dataset, only git data in a sense".
Departs from: main — the database is the store and git is copied at each wake; a makes git the truth and the database a live cache.
Meanwhile: #2829 is out of batch 136 and stays a draft; the three-fix follow-up step waits too.
home: PR #2829; rulings R28 and item 593 a

options.gain: Rebuildable anywhere; cross-account reads need nothing special; no stale copy.
options.how: #2829 is rewritten to that, with a timely export and the three cross-account fixes, and rejoins the next prose batch.
options.label: Git is home, the database is the live view (coordinator's pick)
options.lose: 593 a's wording that the database is the one store is dropped.

options.how: #2829 rejoins the next batch as built.
options.label: The database is the one store; git a timely backup (593 a, #2829 as built)
options.lose: Contradicts decision waiting-data-in-repo; git lags and the Questions tab cannot render from git.

reply: Coordinator 12:10 CST Nov 13: stood pick, not an open question. Fresh lane page-one-store-git-home rewrites #2829 to: git is home, the database is the live view one account writes through, exported timely (593 a's timing kept), plus the three cross-account fixes. #2829 is out of batch 136. The 12:03 CST quote is the retrospective's relay; its source is asked.

title: Rewrite #2829 so git is home and the database is the live view, instead of the database being the one store?
